notes:
The flashy update!
New: every rarity has its own drawn foil instead of a gif (and Ghost Rare turns the whole card monochrome). Pick any rarity under a card preview to see the card in it.
New: Aztec Rare, a rarer take on Ultimate Rare with gold frets and moving runes.
New: drawn summon effects for every summon type, plus effects for activating a Monster, Spell or Trap. Cards with their own sound get a signature effect across the field (lightning for Raigeki, a black hole for Dark Hole...).
New: Effects Gallery in the sidebar - see every foil, summon, activation, signature effect and theme ambience in one place.
New: duels feel better - attack arcs, big hits that freeze and shake, cards shattering to the GY, turn banners, damage numbers, a one-click damage button, coin/dice animations, chain links that resolve, a fanned hand, and a win/loss screen with Rematch / Next Game.
New: cards lean toward your mouse everywhere, previews flip in, buttons light up on hover, and packs rip open with cards fanning out. Premium themes get drawn ambience and a cursor trail.
New: Bulk Buy / Bulk Sell, auto-sell rules for pulls, and Buy Missing for a deck or your wishlist. Packs glow when pity is building, and the shop counts down to new deals.
Faster: theme switching keeps your place, and the Effects Gallery and card sounds load much quicker.
Fixes: Save Replay in the duel menu now works, Z zoom works in pack openings, foils line up on pack cards, and Blood of the OLD SUN is quieter.
